name: ViewBench
summary: 用于评测相机条件长时视频世界模型视角一致性和闭环回访一致性的数据集与诊断基准。
summaryEn: A dataset and diagnostic benchmark for view consistency and loop closure in camera-conditioned long-horizon video world models.
scale: Public v1: 1,059 sequences, about 500K frames; held-out evaluation set excluded
scaleZh: 公开 v1：1,059 条序列、约 50 万帧；不含保留评测集
access: Public training-split entry points; held-out evaluation data not included
accessZh: 公开训练划分入口；不含保留评测数据
verdict: 专门诊断视频世界模型回到旧视角时是否保持世界状态
verdictEn: Diagnoses whether video world models preserve world state when revisiting views
wmNote: 闭环相机轨迹直接测试持久空间记忆和场景一致性。
wmNoteEn: Loop-closure camera paths directly test persistent spatial memory and scene consistency.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - jedward225/viewbench-dataset: Official github repo for "Consistent Video World Model With Geometry-Aware Rotary Position Embedding" · GitHub
evidence.statement: Released UE5 videos contain per-frame SE(3) poses and loop trajectories for camera-conditioned world models. The public training split excludes the held-out evaluation set.
